prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
No kind of change has been shown to be helpful yet, as all 9 tests resulted in no clear effect.
Finish new screen changes showed no clear effect across 3 tests.
Evidence is still thin for adoption new screen, adoption redesign, finish new flow, home redesign, and sign-in hint changes.
Positive predictions were generally too high, particularly for adoption redesign (predicted +12.0%) and new flows.
Negative predictions were too low, as all three tests with negative predictions measured positive or near-zero results.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_screen: +0.8% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, redesign: -0.7% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- finish, new_flow: -2.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: +0.3% after noise correction, 3 test(s)
- home, redesign: +1.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, hint: +0.1% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [choose_path, redesign] Grid Layout Choose Path Redesign: Redesigns the choose path screen layout into a clear grid format contrasting photo custom pets and instant pre-made pets. (why: The choose_path screen has high mean duration (514s) and 23.8% drop-off, showing decision hesitation.)
1: [home, redesign] Centered Waiting Screen Redesign: Redesigns the waiting screen with a centered layout and explicit generation status progress indicator. (why: Home stage median wait time is 201 seconds with an 18.7% drop-off rate during generation.)
2: [sign_in, hint] Account Sync Security Reassurance Hint: Adds a explicit hint text beneath sign-in options confirming pet data cloud persistence. (why: Support receives frequent complaints about lost pets upon re-login.)
3: [home, wait_info] Desktop Readiness Notification Option: Enables desktop readiness notification toggle on the waiting screen so users can multitask while pet generates. (why: Waiting median is 201s (mean 2336s), causing users to abandon during long generation times.)
4: [finish, layout] Compact Layout Home Intro Screen: Changes home_intro layout to compact mode with an embedded desktop controls tip carousel component. (why: Finish step takes a long mean time (5815s) and support receives questions on how to control or hide desktop pets.)
5: [choose_path, hint] Path Choice Story Overview Description: Updates story screen hint to explicitly clarify that custom photo pets can be created anytime later. (why: High mean time in choose_path (514s) indicates anxiety over choosing the wrong initial path.)
6: [adoption, redesign] Split Layout Photo Upload Screen Redesign: Redesigns upload_photos layout to split view with clear photographic guidelines and photo quality tips. (why: Support reported 3 cases of custom pet creation failing or looking wrong due to photo upload issues.)
